title: Remodeled Guest Suite in Quaint Bungalow
description:
Wake up refreshed in an established, quiet neighborhood, ready to discover the city. When not exploring the Middle Tennessee, relax indoors in the open-concept living area, or outdoors in the shared backyard patio and screened in porch. Enjoy the urban chic furnishings, locally inspired decor, and thoughtful touches of color.  Feel confident in the quiet and secure neighborhood with your own private entry and free parking.

The space
Donelson is a neighborhood of Nashville, Tennessee about 6 miles east of downtown Nashville along U.S. Route 70. It is named in honor of John Donelson, co-founder of Nashville and father-in-law of Andrew Jackson, Nashvillian and the 7th President. Lyft/Uber to central downtown is generally ~$12-15, but can fluxuate with major events in the area.

Given our proximity to the airport and downtown, Lyft/Uber is an easy way to get around. We have parking available if bringing a personal car or renting. There are two grocery stores and a few great dining options within walking distance.

This is a smoke-free property.

Guest access
While the suite is attached, it has no open access or communal space with our main home.  The guest space is accessible via it's own private entrance (pictured) in the rear of the home.

Other things to note
Nashville Metro code requires inclusion of our current and active Airbnb permit: Permit number: 2018O3689O issued in July of 2018.

Howdy Y'all!  We're Aaron and Bethany. Originally midwesterners, we're currently loving the southern hospitality of Nashville, TN. We're adventurers at heart. We love the outdoors and exploring - whether that be finding a small trail leading through the woods or an urban adventure to find a local dive. You'll often find us with family and/or friends as it's one of our biggest joys -hosting at our place for a themed party or simply meeting folks for dinner and drinks. 

We are very relaxed and easy going but understand the need to be responsive and attentive to our guests' needs. Just as we hope to find in our hosts, we aim to provide comfort and ease through our accommodations and communication. Our goal is to provide utmost privacy while being available should a need arise.
